messages:
maya: FYI: planning a coordinated roll of v3.0.1 for api/runtime/console/router in tonight's change window (23:30-01:30 UTC). Canary plan: ap-south -> us-east -> eu-central. We'll start small and expand if green.

ci-bot: CI pipeline complete for tag v3.0.1. All tests passed (unit+int+smoke).

deploy-bot: Initiating canary: runtime v3.0.1 at 23:38 UTC region=ap-south target=5%

liam: Router config includes new header x-rwd-client and an updated cookie TTL. Applying router config to staging now.

router-bot: Router staging apply: success. No schema drift.

sofia: Console change is a telemetry opt-in (flag: console.telemetry.v3). Enabling for 3% during ap-south canary. No UI schema changes.

jared: Drafting quick notes for customers. Will hold until us-east canary completes.

deploy-bot: ap-south runtime canary steady for 12m. p95 and error budget within thresholds. Advancing router canary to 10% in ap-south.

liam: Router canary in ap-south looks good. Header propagating and cookie stickiness verified.

deploy-bot: Kicking off us-east canary for runtime v3.0.1 at 00:05 UTC target=10%

monitor-bot: Alert: slight uptick in CPU avg on runtime hosts in us-east (avg +18%). No errors yet.

runtime-ops: Investigating CPU spike. Early hypothesis: q6 quant path is triggering extra kernel copies on some batch sizes.

maya: Pause canary expansion in us-east for now. @runtime-ops dig into kernel behavior and @liam hold router changes in us-east.

liam: Holding router rollout in us-east. Notifying ops to keep router pins at previous weights.

runtime-ops: Found host-group-12 with noisy GC cycles causing CPU jumps. Marking host-group-12 for drain and reboot.

deploy-bot: Host-group-12 drained from canary pool. Traffic rebalanced. us-east canary back to 10% without hg-12.

monitor-bot: CPU averages returning to baseline after host drain. p95 stable.

ops-oncall: Keeping elevated p95 alert for next 30m. Will escalate if CPU > baseline+25% sustained.

maya: Two options: 1) continue rollout regionally with hg-12 excluded and proceed, or 2) pin router in us-east back to v2.x runtime until we complete deeper analysis. Thoughts?

jared: Lean toward pinning router back to v2.x in us-east until gc root cause is known. Safer for customers.

sofia: Agree. Console telemetry may also be noisy during GC flaps; pin avoids impacting opt-in users.

liam: I can issue router pin quickly. Proposed command:
```
routerctl set-route-weight api-useast v2.9.7 100
```

maya: Approve the router pin. @deploy-bot, apply pin and pause v3.0.1 rollout in us-east. Document the rollback steps.

deploy-bot: Applying router pin in us-east to v2.9.7 at 00:48 UTC. Pausing v3.0.1 rollout for us-east. Notifying runtime-ops and oncall.

deploy-bot: Pin applied successfully. Traffic now converging to v2.9.7 in us-east. Observability: p95 and CPU trending to baseline.

jared: Updating release_notes with a short incident note: us-east pinned due to noisy GC on certain host-group. Will include timeline and follow-up ticket.

runtime-ops: Opening RW-5120 to track GC investigation and host health; assigning to runtime infra. We'll replay the workload on a staging replica with instrumented GC.

liam: Router audit link: https://internal.redwood/audit/router/1795001123-pin-useast

sofia: Created console follow-up RW-5121 to validate telemetry gating and to ensure no additional opt-in surface is impacted.

ops-oncall: I'll monitor the pinned region for 2 hours. If everything stable, we can consider re-running canary with host-group replacement.

maya: Action items recap: 1) runtime-ops continue GC triage and test a fix branch, 2) liam confirm router pin and update runbook, 3) jared publish interim release note and customer comms, 4) sofia coordinate console gating audit. We'll reconvene before attempting to resume us-east canary. Thanks all.

alice-bizdev: Heads-up: a few customers in us-east reported slight performance variance, pinged them with the interim note. Appreciate the quick pin.

jared: Interim note published: https://internal.redwood/releases/notes/v3.0.1-us-east-pin

maya: Closing thread. Reopen when triage is complete or if we need to resume rollout. :white_check_mark:
